nodes.description: Owner address set in constructor from _msgSender(); gates onlyOwner functions.
Reflection balance mapping updated in _transferStandard and _takeTeam.
ERC20 allowance mapping written by _approve and read/consumed by transferFrom.
Blacklist mapping; owner can permanently block addresses from transferring via setBots.
Per-address cooldown timestamps compared with block.timestamp in _transfer.
Total reflections, reduced in _reflectFee, basis of _getRate and tokenFromReflection.
Payable fee recipient 1; also the privileged caller for manualswap/manualsend.
Payable fee recipient 2 receiving half of the accumulated ETH.
Uniswap V2 router used for swaps and liquidity; set in openTrading.
Liquidity pair address created in openTrading; transfer-side checks depend on it.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Enables automatic token-to-ETH swapping inside _transfer.
Owner-controlled toggle for the buy cooldown logic.
Maximum transaction amount, lowered to 210000e9 in openTrading.
Fee exemption mapping consulted in _transfer.
Reflection fee percentage passed into _getTValues.
Team fee percentage passed into _getTValues.
One-shot flag guarding openTrading initialization.
Accumulated token fees, increased in _reflectFee.
Returns msg.sender; used by transfer, approve, transferFrom and the constructor.
Returns the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner function that transfers ownership to address(0).
Sets fee wallets, mints full reflection supply to deployer and seeds fee exclusions.
Public ERC20 transfer forwarding to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; calls _transfer then decrements allowance.
Public ERC20 approve forwarding to _approve.
Core transfer logic: bot checks, cooldown check against block.timestamp, pair-side fee selection, and external swap/ETH distribution before final balance settlement.
Approves the router and swaps contract tokens for ETH; protected by lockTheSwap.
Splits the contract ETH balance and pushes it to both fee wallets.
onlyOwner setup: creates pair, adds liquidity, enables swap/cooldown, sets max tx and approves pair.
onlyOwner blacklist writer; loops over an array of addresses.
onlyOwner blacklist remover.
Privileged manual swap callable only when _msgSender() equals _feeAddrWallet1.
Privileged manual ETH distribution callable only when _msgSender() equals _feeAddrWallet1.
Applies reflection balance updates, team take and fee reflection, then emits Transfer.
Moves the team share of reflections into the contract address.
Reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
Combines _getTValues and _getRValues using the current rate.
Computes token-level fee, team and transfer amounts.
Computes reflection-level amounts from the token amounts and rate.
Divides reflection supply by token supply.
Returns the current reflection and token supplies.
onlyOwner toggle for cooldownEnabled.
Public balance query; also called internally on address(this) during _transfer.
Converts a reflection amount into a token amount using _getRate.
Internal allowance writer with zero-address checks.
Attacker-controlled caller returned by _msgSender.
Miner-influenceable time source used for cooldown checks and swap/liquidity deadlines.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with an arbitrary path and zero slippage protection.
ETH pushing via _feeAddrWallet1.transfer and _feeAddrWallet2.transfer, executed before tokens are settled.
External addLiquidityETH call forwarding the whole contract ETH balance with 0 minimums in openTrading.
_transfer parameter `from`, the sender address.
_transfer parameter `to`, the recipient address.
_transfer parameter `amount`, the transferred amount.
sendETHToFee parameter `amount`, the ETH to be split.
swapTokensForEth parameter `tokenAmount`, the tokens to swap.
Local variable holding balanceOf(address(this)) inside _transfer.
setBots parameter `bots_`, the array of addresses to blacklist.
Local variable holding the reflection rate inside _getRate.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns the untrusted caller address.
Constructor assigns the deployer from _msgSender() and sets _owner.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender into _transfer.
Caller-controlled sender reaches _transfer, which performs external swap and ETH transfers before final state settlement.
manualswap authorizes solely by comparing _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes solely by comparing _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
Buy path is gated by require(cooldown[to] < block.timestamp) and cooldown is set to block.timestamp + 30 seconds.
block.timestamp is forwarded as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is forwarded as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner against _owner.
openTrading is guarded by onlyOwner against _owner.
setBots is guarded by onlyOwner against _owner and mutates the blacklist.
delBot is guarded by onlyOwner against _owner.
setCooldownEnabled is guarded by onlyOwner against _owner.
Constructor initializes _owner from the deployer address.
Constructor mints the full reflection supply into _rOwned of the deployer.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom reads and decrements _allowances for the caller.
approve delegates to _approve.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
_transfer hard-reverts when bots[from] or bots[to] is true, giving the owner blacklist power over users.
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping using block.timestamp.
_transfer checks _isExcludedFromFee to decide fee application.
_transfer calls balanceOf(address(this)) to size the contract token balance.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth, an external call that happens before the recipient balances are settled by _tokenTransfer.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee, pushing ETH out before shares are settled.
_transfer finalizes via _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard.
_transfer enforces the amount <= _maxTxAmount limit on pair buys.
swapTokensForEth reads the router address and WETH from it.
swapTokensForEth executes the router swap external call.
sendETHToFee executes the ETH transfers to both fee wallets.
sendETHToFee transfers half of the ETH to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee transfers half of the ETH to _feeAddrWallet2.
openTrading assigns the Uniswap router address.
openTrading creates and stores the Uniswap pair.
openTrading executes the addLiquidityETH external call forwarding all contract ETH.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount to 210000 tokens.
setBots writes true into the bots mapping for every supplied address.
delBot clears an address from the bots blacklist.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the whole contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee on the whole contract ETH balance.
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount from sender and adds rTransferAmount to recipient reflection balances.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard routes the team share through _takeTeam.
_transferStandard routes the reflection fee through _reflectFee.
_takeTeam and _reflectFee are paired settlement steps in the transfer pipeline.
_takeTeam calls _getRate to compute the team reflection amount.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the fee reflection amount.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by the token fee.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues calls _getRate for the current rate.
_getValues passes _feeAddr1 as the tax fee percentage.
_getValues passes _feeAddr2 as the team fee percentage.
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_getRate divides reflection supply by token supply into currentRate.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal.
balanceOf converts reflections to tokens via tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection calls _getRate.
The router swap is an external call executed before _transfer finalizes balances, allowing a malicious token/pair callback to re-enter.
Pushing ETH to the fee wallet before settlement allows a contract fee recipient to re-enter _transfer through its fallback.
addLiquidityETH interacts with external factory/pair contracts during setup, an external callback surface.
swap execution is gated by the swapEnabled flag read in _transfer.
swap execution is gated by the inSwap guard set by lockTheSwap.
`from` parameter drives the bot, pair and fee-exclusion branches in _transfer.
`to` parameter drives the cooldown and pair branches in _transfer.
`amount` parameter is compared to _maxTxAmount and split in _getTValues.
`amount` parameter is halved with div(2) before each ETH transfer.
`tokenAmount` parameter is the swap input passed to the router.
contractTokenBalance is the local used to size the swap call.
`bots_` array elements are written into the blacklist mapping.
currentRate is the local quotient produced by _getRate.
